name: dsh-kujira
description: DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘桌宠 —— 独立重写的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。零构建依赖：lib/ 里的 JS 就是源码，改完刷新即生效。
_comment: main: lib/index.js      宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name / inject / apply）
exports['./client']     浏览器半侧入口；DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-kujira/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch        声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件 cordis.patch.yml 安装后自动进配置树层栈
dsh.client              声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖与平台（web）
files                   若将来要 npm publish，只发这些
peerDependencies        运行时由 DSH 宿主提供，本包不打包；全部标 optional 避免 pnpm 因解析不到而报错

scripts.test: node tools/check-assets.mjs && node tools/test-logic.mjs && node tools/test-host.mjs && node tools/test-usage.mjs && node tools/test-live.mjs && node tools/test-controls.mjs && node tools/test-balance.mjs && node tools/test-i18n.mjs && node tools/test-inventory.mjs && node tools/test-usage-preview.mjs && node tools/test-activity.mjs && node tools/test-scheduler.mjs && node tools/test-client.mjs && node tools/test-session-access.mjs && node tools/test-markdown.mjs && node tools/test-companion-effects.mjs && node tools/test-video-player.mjs && node tools/test-rolling-amount.mjs && node tools/test-task-tabs.mjs && node tools/test-usage-index.mjs
scripts.reinstall: dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-kujira && dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
scripts.lint: eslint lib/client.js lib/shared/client lib/shared/task lib/shared/locales lib/shared/messages.js lib/shared/activity-ui.js lib/host/resources.js && stylelint "lib/styles/*.css" lib/appearance.css
